column2: [intro]
I rise in the morning with a smile so bright,
I was born to shine, it's in my birthright.
I walk down the street, everyone greets me,
For I’m the king, the idol of the spree.
It’s too easy, it drives me wild,
Everything goes right, it’s a bit too mild.
I’m so amazing, even words can’t convey,
Just how incredible I am each day.
I make people laugh, I’m a true clown,
My jokes are so great, I’m the talk of the town.
I sing my songs, and they’re loved by all,
For I’m an artist, a real treasure, standing tall.
Too easy, I’m the best by far,
I win every time, that’s who we are.
I’m a genius, a true prodigy,
In this world, I’m a living legacy.
[ solo ]
It’s too easy, it drives me wild,
Everything goes right, it’s a bit too mild.
I’m so amazing, even words can’t convey,
Just how incredible I am each day.
[outro]
